g.text: Drag the labels from the word bank to the correct positions on the flower diagram. Match each part with its corresponding label.
Petal: The colorful parts that attract pollinators
Sepal: Green leaf-like structures that protect the bud
Stamen: The male reproductive part (consists of anther and filament)
Pistil: The female reproductive part (consists of stigma, style, and ovary)
Stigma: Sticky top part that catches pollen
Receptacle: Base that holds all flower parts
Are you sure you want to reset all labels?
This will clear all your progress and return all labels to the word bank.
